title: Picks, per stock
description: What today.sh said about each stock at every run (the Range in price, the entry price and the chance), and what the price did. Runs come from summary --record, which today.sh and schedule-today.sh do by default.

target.queryText:
SELECT as_of AS time,
       symbol || ' flagged: chance ' || printf('%.0f%%', chance * 100)
         || ', edge ' || printf('%+.0f', (chance - base_rate) * 100) || ' points' AS text,
       symbol AS tags
FROM summary_pick
WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND flagged = 1 AND symbol IN (${symbol:sqlstring}) AND as_of BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000
target.rawQueryText:
SELECT as_of AS time,
       symbol || ' flagged: chance ' || printf('%.0f%%', chance * 100)
         || ', edge ' || printf('%+.0f', (chance - base_rate) * 100) || ' points' AS text,
       symbol AS tags
FROM summary_pick
WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND flagged = 1 AND symbol IN (${symbol:sqlstring}) AND as_of BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000

list.name: family
list.label: Model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT substr(model_version, 1, instr(model_version, '/') - 1) FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT substr(model_version, 1, instr(model_version, '/') - 1) FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' ORDER BY 1
list.description: Which today.sh model's runs to show: sklearn-target-0.5pct-close is the default (+0.5% at some point before the close); ...-stop0.5pct-close is today.sh --stop 0.5 (+0.5% before it falls 0.5%).

list.name: symbol
list.label: Stocks
list.query: SELECT symbol FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of = (SELECT MAX(as_of) FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000) ORDER BY chance DESC
list.definition: SELECT symbol FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of = (SELECT MAX(as_of) FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000) ORDER BY chance DESC
list.description: One chart per stock, listed by chance at the latest run in the time range (the first is the most likely). Tick several to compare them.

panels.title: Latest run
panels.description: The minute of the latest recorded today.sh run in the time range (schedule-today.sh runs it every 10 minutes, 09:20 to 14:50).

targets.queryText: SELECT MAX(as_of) * 1000 AS "Latest run" FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT MAX(as_of) * 1000 AS "Latest run" FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000

panels.title: Base rate now
panels.description: How often any stock reached the target from this time of day in the held-out month. A chance near it says nothing.

targets.queryText: SELECT MAX(base_rate) * 100 AS "Base rate" FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of = (SELECT MAX(as_of) FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT MAX(base_rate) * 100 AS "Base rate" FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of = (SELECT MAX(as_of) FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000)

panels.title: Flagged now
panels.description: Stocks whose chance is 10+ points above the base rate at the latest run.

targets.queryText: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(flagged), 0) AS "Flagged" FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of = (SELECT MAX(as_of) FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(flagged), 0) AS "Flagged" FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of = (SELECT MAX(as_of) FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000)

panels.title: 50%+ now
panels.description: Stocks with a chance of 50% or more at the latest run.

targets.queryText: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(passed), 0) AS "50%+" FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of = (SELECT MAX(as_of) FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(passed), 0) AS "50%+" FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of = (SELECT MAX(as_of) FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000)

panels.title: Latest run, every stock
panels.description: Every stock at the latest run, most likely first. Edge is the chance minus the base rate, in points; ✓ marks a stock 10+ points above it. Range in price is the p25-p75 of the best price expected later today; Entry is the most to pay, 0.6% below its low end (or the price then).

targets.queryText:
SELECT rank AS "#", symbol AS "Stock", price AS "Price", chance * 100 AS "Chance",
       CASE WHEN base_rate IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (chance - base_rate) * 100 END AS "Edge",
       CASE WHEN flagged = 1 THEN '✓' ELSE '' END AS "Flag",
       gain_p50 AS "Median gain",
       price * (1 + gain_p25 / 100.0) AS "Range low", price * (1 + gain_p75 / 100.0) AS "Range high",
       MIN(price, price * (1 + gain_p25 / 100.0) * (1 - 0.6 / 100.0)) AS "Entry"
FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of = (SELECT MAX(as_of) FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000)
ORDER BY rank
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT rank AS "#", symbol AS "Stock", price AS "Price", chance * 100 AS "Chance",
       CASE WHEN base_rate IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (chance - base_rate) * 100 END AS "Edge",
       CASE WHEN flagged = 1 THEN '✓' ELSE '' END AS "Flag",
       gain_p50 AS "Median gain",
       price * (1 + gain_p25 / 100.0) AS "Range low", price * (1 + gain_p75 / 100.0) AS "Range high",
       MIN(price, price * (1 + gain_p25 / 100.0) * (1 - 0.6 / 100.0)) AS "Entry"
FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of = (SELECT MAX(as_of) FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000)
ORDER BY rank

panels.title: Flagged stocks and the base rate, run by run
panels.description: At each run: how many stocks were flagged (10+ points above the base rate) and how many had 50%+, and the base rate itself. The base rate falls through the day, as less of it is left.

targets.queryText:
SELECT as_of AS time, SUM(flagged) AS "Flagged", SUM(passed) AS "50%+", MAX(base_rate) * 100 AS "Base rate"
FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000
GROUP BY as_of ORDER BY as_of
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT as_of AS time, SUM(flagged) AS "Flagged", SUM(passed) AS "50%+", MAX(base_rate) * 100 AS "Base rate"
FROM summary_pick WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND as_of BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000
GROUP BY as_of ORDER BY as_of

panels.title: $symbol: Range in price, entry and chance at each run
panels.description: One candle per today.sh run (time along the bottom). The candle spans the **Range in price**: the p25 to p75 of the best price expected later today. The orange line is the **Entry price** (the most to pay: 0.6% below the range's low end, or the price then). The bars, on the right axis, are the **chance** of the target at that run. The dashed line is the price at the run. Green markers: runs where the stock was flagged.

targets.queryText:
SELECT as_of AS time,
       price * (1 + gain_p25 / 100.0) AS open,
       price * (1 + gain_p75 / 100.0) AS high,
       price * (1 + gain_p25 / 100.0) AS low,
       price * (1 + gain_p75 / 100.0) AS close,
       MIN(price, price * (1 + gain_p25 / 100.0) * (1 - 0.6 / 100.0)) AS "Entry price",
       chance * 100 AS "Chance",
       price AS "Price then",
       CASE WHEN base_rate IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (chance - base_rate) * 100 END AS "Edge"
FROM summary_pick
WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND symbol = '${symbol}' AND as_of BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000
ORDER BY as_of
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT as_of AS time,
       price * (1 + gain_p25 / 100.0) AS open,
       price * (1 + gain_p75 / 100.0) AS high,
       price * (1 + gain_p25 / 100.0) AS low,
       price * (1 + gain_p75 / 100.0) AS close,
       MIN(price, price * (1 + gain_p25 / 100.0) * (1 - 0.6 / 100.0)) AS "Entry price",
       chance * 100 AS "Chance",
       price AS "Price then",
       CASE WHEN base_rate IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (chance - base_rate) * 100 END AS "Edge"
FROM summary_pick
WHERE kind = 'today' AND model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND symbol = '${symbol}' AND as_of BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000
ORDER BY as_of

panels.title: $symbol: what the price did (minute candles)
panels.description: stock-analyzer's one-minute candles for the same time range, read without writing to its database; the candle still forming is left out. Compare with the predicted range on the left: did the price get there? Green markers: runs where the stock was flagged.

targets.queryText:
SELECT ts_epoch AS time, open, high, low, close, volume
FROM v_intraday_merged
WHERE symbol = '${symbol}' AND ts_epoch BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000
  AND COALESCE(source, '') != 'forming'
ORDER BY ts_epoch
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ts_epoch AS time, open, high, low, close, volume
FROM v_intraday_merged
WHERE symbol = '${symbol}' AND ts_epoch BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000
  AND COALESCE(source, '') != 'forming'
ORDER BY ts_epoch
